brief:
Rain swept through displacement camps in Gaza, submerging tents and leaving displaced residents contending with flooded shelters. The downpour affected multiple sites housing those forced from their homes, exacerbating already dire humanitarian conditions in the territory.

Displaced Palestinians sheltering in makeshift tent camps face mounting challenges from weather exposure alongside existing shortages of food, water, and medical care. The flooding threatened to worsen sanitary conditions in the overcrowded settlements.
title: Heavy rains flood displacement camps across Gaza
